meta.name: video-editing
meta.description: AI-assisted video editing workflows for cutting, structuring, and augmenting real footage. Covers the full pipeline from raw capture through FFmpeg, Remotion, ElevenLabs, fal.ai, and final polish in Descript or CapCut. Use when the user wants to edit video, cut footage, create vlogs, or build video content.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI辅助剪辑、结构化和增强视频素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要AI辅助完成从原始素材到成片的视频编辑工作流
copy.tagline_en: Edit, structure, and enhance video footage with AI assistance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI-assisted video editing from raw footage to final cut

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你规划视频剪辑流程：分析原始素材的转录文本，找出最佳片段，生成剪辑决策列表，并编写 FFmpeg 和 Remotion 代码来执行剪切、拼接、添加字幕和特效等操作。
howto.when: 当你想编辑视频、剪切素材、制作 vlog 或构建视频内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这段4小时录制的转录文本，找出8个最强片段用于24分钟vlog。
say.note: Claude 会生成剪辑决策列表和 FFmpeg 剪切命令。

say.text: 为这个视频生成一个带标题覆盖的 Remotion 合成。
say.note: Claude 会编写 Remotion 代码并指导渲染。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you plan the video editing workflow: analyze raw footage transcripts, identify the best segments, generate an edit decision list, and write FFmpeg and Remotion code for cutting, concatenating, adding overlays, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to edit video, cut footage, create vlogs, or build video content.

say_en.text: Analyze this 4-hour recording transcript and identify the 8 strongest segments for a 24-minute vlog.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an edit decision list and FFmpeg cut commands.

say_en.text: Create a Remotion composition for this video with a title overlay.
say_en.note: Claude will write the Remotion code and guide rendering.
